attackPreconditions: A model can invoke the write-capability desktop stop tool while the user has confirmation enabled.
impact: A model-controlled boolean could bypass the user's configured confirmation before stopping a PreBase-owned desktop app.
evidence: desktopTools forwarded force=true; the command selected desktop.stop() rather than confirmation-aware desktop.kill().
rootCause: A model-supplied flag was treated as authority to weaken a human-approval boundary.
remediation: Removed force from the tool schema and invocation; the command delegates only to stopDesktopSessionForMagnus(), which calls kill().
test: runtimeSafetyBoundaries.test.ts verifies the callable command boundary invokes kill even with a legacy force argument.
residualRisk: Users may intentionally disable the confirmation setting; that remains an explicit local configuration decision.

attackPreconditions: A workspace process or preview supplies a sustained stream of diagnostic evidence.
impact: Unbounded retained strings could consume renderer memory and enlarge agent context.
evidence: Multiple session update paths appended evidence arrays without an entry or byte limit.
rootCause: Evidence history had no retention policy.
remediation: Bound retention to 200 entries, 4,000 characters per entry, and 64,000 total characters; reports droppedCount and truncated metadata.
test: runtimeSafetyBoundaries.test.ts exercises count, character, per-entry, newest-tail, and drop behavior.
residualRisk: Actual page/terminal capture sources need GUI lifecycle and sustained-load validation.
